'''Tulimus''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Havoc (Imperial-class)|''Havoc'']] during its bombardment of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Edan Base]] on the planet [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. The destroyer was eventually destroyed by Rebels.
